description: This is a Java source file defining a unit test class 'Focus2AndroidTest' for Android's focus navigation logic. It includes setup for UI components and test methods to verify focus behavior.

classes.name: Focus2AndroidTest
classes.description: Android test class for verifying focus navigation behavior using FocusFinder. Extends AndroidTestCase, sets up layout, and contains test methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes FocusFinder and inflates the layout, then finds specific Button views and measures/layouts the root view.

methods.name: testPreconditions
methods.description: Verifies that the buttons are properly initialized and layout positions are as expected.

methods.name: testGoingRightFromLeftButtonJumpsOverCenterToRight
methods.description: Tests that the focus moves correctly from the left button to the right button when navigating right.

methods.name: testGoingLeftFromRightButtonGoesToCenter
methods.description: Tests that focus moves correctly from the right button to the center button when navigating left.
